title: fix(spec): the liveness ledger grades field.settledWhen live
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGq53dJp4Qhk7xzCoABTvh2)_

Fixes #26727

## What changes

- `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` › `settledWhen`: `planned` → `live`, `verifiedAt` 2026-10-27, `evidenceScope` `cross-repo` → `in-repo` (the renderer is `ui/` since #25712). Evidence: `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/deadlineSettled.ts#isDeadlineSettled` (the one host helper), `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx#resolveDueLike` (the date and datetime cells drop overdue wording and colour on a settled verdict), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx#useObjectGridGenerateColumns`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx#FieldFace`. New `producer`: the grid's three column paths and `plugin-detail` `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS` copy the key onto cell metadata; `objectGridRowLoad.ts#useObjectGridRowLoad` and `ListView.tsx#ListView` fetch the predicate's operands. The note names the other hosts that ask the same helper (DetailSection, HeaderHighlight, RelatedList, ObjectKanban, ObjectGallery, ListViewCompact, ObjectTree), each pinned by its own `deadlineSettled-11815` test. The row had no `authorWarn` / `authorHint`, so none is dropped.
- Same file › `dueLike` note: its "PARTIAL until objectui#11815 lands" clause was false (the grid copies the key on all three column paths, and `DUE_LIKE_FIELD_NAME` is gone). Note only; the status was already `live`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`: regenerated by `gen:liveness-counts`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`: one sentence on the `field` row recording the flip and its counts.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts` › `cel-field-deadline-settled`: `experimental` / `unevaluated` ("NO EVALUATOR FOUND … objectui @55e90fd has no `settledWhen` read") → `enforced` / `fail-soft-log`, enforcement naming `isDeadlineSettled → evalRowPredicate → evalFieldPredicate → celEngine`. A faulting predicate is warned once per predicate text (`warnPredicateFailure`, via `evalFieldPredicate`, since `isDeadlineSettled` passes no `warnOnError`) and answers not settled, which is the `cel-field-rule` tier.
- `.changeset/26727-settled-when-ledger-live.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch (the `liveness/` folder ships in the spec tarball).

**`object.tenancy` is already right on main, and this PR leaves it alone.** The QA's "no `tenancy` row" reading is not true at 2720874a: `object.json` has a `tenancy` container with two children, both `live` and both checked at this head. `enabled`: `isTenancyDisabled` (`object.zod.ts`) is called by `injected-system-columns.ts#resolveInjectedSystemColumns` (withholds `organization_id`), `sql-driver.ts#computeTenantField` (no driver org scope) and `security-plugin.ts#getObjectSecurityMeta` (`tenancyDisabled` posture). `tenantField`: `computeTenantField` honours a declared column that exists on the object. Like the other container rows here (`enable`), the container itself carries no status.

**Moved counts:**
- `state-counts/field.md` `field` row: live 99 → 100, planned 6 → 5 (106 classified, unchanged). It counts the `field` ledger rows by verdict, and one row moved verdict.
- `check:liveness` producer census: live rows citing a producer reads 152 at this head. The `settledWhen` row is the only row that gained a `producer`, so main reads 151; that is inferred from the diff, not run on main. This count is not pinned; the gate only reports it.
- No other pin moved. The expression-conformance ledger has no per-state count pin. Its `unevaluated` pin judges each `unevaluated` row's cell, and this row has left that set.

No `.describe()` change: the `settledWhen` / `dueLike` describe strings never said planned. The `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` deadline section already describes the live behaviour.

## Why

The ledger tells authors and agents whether a key does anything. A `planned` grade on a key the console reads makes an agent treat it as inert. Re-measured on main 2720874a, after the QA's 3fcafcd3.

## Verification

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

_Keep one value on each of the two lines above, each line starting with its key.
[Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum)
item 5 says what they mean._

Tests and gates, run on head 1e5831a5:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`: exit 0 (after `gen:liveness-counts`; before it, the gate reported `field.md` stale with exactly the 99/6 → 100/5 move above). `check:empty-state`: exit 0.
- spec `vitest run scripts/liveness`: 12 files, 358 tests passed. lint `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`: 110 passed.
- dogfood `expression-conformance.test.ts`: 8 passed (with `@objectstack/verify` built).
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 59 commands. 58 exit 0, including `check:generated`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` and `check:published-files`. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3: it needs a full repo build, so nothing was measured. That is not a finding.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` was not run locally: the diff is JSON, Markdown and one string-literal row, so CI's lint decides.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
